name: Acceptance suite-3 test 93 - ec2:DescribeInstances legitimately uses Resource:* (no remediable wildcard)
note: docs/acceptance-suite-3.md Campaign F (false-positive control). ec2:DescribeInstances does not support resource-level permissions; Resource:* is required. The engine must not emit a broad-write edge or a remediable WILDCARD-RESOURCE finding, and must not recommend a wildcard-resource fix AWS cannot implement for this action. Informational enumeration/read only.
rationale: The EC2 Describe* family (including ec2:DescribeInstances) lists resource type '*' with no resource-level permissions in the Service Authorization Reference, so AWS mandates Resource:*. It is read-only enumeration carrying no escalation, and the mandatory wildcard must not be penalized as an avoidable over-scope. Mirrors fixtures/negative/aws-required-wildcard-resource-not-penalized.json. Ref: AWS Service Authorization Reference, 'Actions, resources, and condition keys for Amazon EC2'.
